The '''Phoebos-class starfighter''' was a high-performance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], and one of the fastest available as of [[137 ABY]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Characteristics==
A top-of-the-line starfighter manufactured by [[Ubrikkian Transports/Legends|Ubrikkian Transports]], the Phoebos was designed for one thing only; speed, speed, and more speed.<ref name="LECG" /> Sleek and aerodynamic, the Phoebos was exceptionally fast in atmosphere but truly excelled in open space, with the vessel being a common sight on racing circuits throughout the galaxy.<ref name="LECG" /> Boasting sizable defense systems for a sporting craft, the Phoebos possessed powerful shields and double light laser cannons.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
The Phoebos was popular with wealthy [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]], small-time smugglers, and thieves, and was frequently seen as a status symbol for "new nobles" of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="LECG" /> As the Empire started restricting personal starfighter ownership, Ubrikkian classified the Phoebos as a recreational vehicle. This allowed Ubrikkian to bring a top-of-the-line starfighter to the market without running the risk of being shut down or converted to producing Imperial starfighters, as had happened to various other [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturers.<ref name="LECG" />
